question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**a community service."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To indicate whether a noun is specific or general, a term called an **article** is used before the noun.
 
• There are three types of articles:
 
 
• **'a' **used before consonants when identity of noun is unknown.
 
• **'an' **use before vowel when identity of noun is unknown.
 
• 'The' is used before a noun to show that the reader is aware of the noun's identification.
 
 
 
• **​**The most appropriate option is ' **a community service**.'
